title: Talk track for SEs
intro: About ten minutes. Start the lab (`./scripts/run.sh`, then http://127.0.0.1:4901/), press `P` for presenter mode if the room is large (Esc leaves it; the banner stays). The header toggle is Mock | Live and starts on Mock. Everything on screen in Mock mode is simulated: say so once, early. The banner on every tab says it too.
point: Before a customer connects ChatGPT, Claude or any MCP client to an MCP server, score its authorization: discovery documents, the 401 challenge, PKCE, the resource parameter and how clients register. Each failed check names its own fix and its spec clause.

flow.title: Set the scene
flow.say: Pick a vertical (banking, travel or retail). "The target is a made-up MCP server. Nothing leaves this machine."

flow.title: Good server
flow.say: Scorecard, S01: 100%. Open one check: evidence, MUST or SHOULD, severity, fix hint, spec citation. "MUST counts more than SHOULD; a check that was not tested is left out, not guessed."

flow.title: Break one thing
flow.say: Pick two or three: no protected resource metadata (S02), empty first parameter in WWW-Authenticate (S03), S256 not advertised (S05). "Each defect fails exactly its own checks and nothing else." Then Diagram: Simulate to show where the client gets stuck.

flow.title: Gateway warning
flow.say: "A gateway can answer RFC 9728 metadata for any path, so a probe proves the gateway is there, not that the application is." The lab warns instead of passing.

flow.title: Registration
flow.say: DCR versus CIMD side by side. "Which one a client prefers is in the Clients tab, with each line marked verified or UNVERIFIED."

flow.title: 401 then 403
flow.say: The step-up path: 401 with a scope hint, then 403 `insufficient_scope`. S16 shows the step-up failing when the 403 has the wrong shape.

flow.title: Live probe (optional)
flow.say: Switch the header to Live. The Probe tab scores one URL you type, read-only, with a confirmation gate. Show it refusing a private address and a cross-origin redirect. Against anything real, run it from the host, never from Docker (see `docs/live-checks.md`). Switch back to Mock when you are done.

flow.title: Reset
flow.say: The Reset button (or `npm run reset`) clears the last scorecard; the diagram returns to its starting positions.

questions.q: What does ChatGPT or Claude need?
questions.a: The Clients tab. ChatGPT: read from OpenAI's Apps SDK authentication page (verified in `docs/references.md`). Claude: UNVERIFIED, the help page could not be fetched; the lab claims nothing beyond the generic MCP spec.
MCP authorization 2025-11-25. Other versions are UNVERIFIED.

questions.q: Does a 100% mean it will connect?
questions.a: No. It means the discovery documents and challenge look right. Checks that need a token or would register a client are not run in the Live probe.
No. That is mcp-tools; this lab scores authorization only.

questions.q: Does a Ping product pass these?
questions.a: The lab makes no product claim. UNVERIFIED.

questions.q: Does it call out to anything?
questions.a: No by default. A network guard blocks non-loopback sockets, and the Live probe only reaches loopback unless the owner enables external probing on the host.

trouble: `npm run doctor` checks Node, the bind address, the port, the network guard and every scenario. If the page cannot reach the server, the process is not running. If the diagram is in an odd state, press Reset.
